name: Service more frequently in dusty conditions
quote: Service more frequently when operating in severe conditions: dusty, wet, muddy, high speed, or frequent starting/stopping.

name: Wet operating conditions service frequency
quote: Service more frequently when operating in severe conditions: dusty, wet, muddy, high speed, or frequent starting/stopping.

name: salt_wash
quote: After riding in an area where the roads are salted or near the ocean, immediately wash your vehicle with cold water. Do not use warm water as it accelerates the chemical reac- tion of the salt.

name: Keep the battery well charged during cold weather
quote: Keep the battery well charged especially during cold weather.
